messages:
mina: Reporting a weird onboarding failure hitting embeddings + rerank. Sampleapp got a 200 but parsing failed silently — some items parsed fine, others missing, ranks were garbage. Looks correlated with auth refresh + retry.
cheng: which SDK / language? any raw payloads?
mina: Node sampleapp (axios). Repro: batch 10 -> expire token mid-flight -> SDK refresh+retry -> final response occasionally contains a mix of objects where some items use field "embedding" and others use "vectors". Our parser only reads "embedding" so those become empty vectors and downstream reranker gives weird scores.
otto: wait, server returning two different envelope keys in the same response? can you paste sanitized snippet?
mina: snippet (sanitized):
```
{"data":[{"id":0,"embedding":[...512 floats...]},{"id":1,"vectors":[...512 floats...]},{"id":2,"embedding":[...512 floats...]}],"model":"redwood-embed-1","meta":{}}
```
cheng: that's odd. Two possibilities: 1) two different service processes (different versions) wrote chunks to the same response due to connection reuse/interleave, or 2) older retry used a different envelope because a model variant returned a slightly different schema.
otto: combined with auth-refresh this smells like chunk interleaving + version skew. When the first request started, it hit pod A (old build that used "vectors"), then retry went to pod B (new build that uses "embedding"), and because of socket pooling the chunks got concatenated into one logical body.
mina: logs:
[3241594826] REQ id=batch-xy model=redwood-embed-1
[3241594827] RESP partial id=batch-xy -> chunked
[3241594832] AUTH refresh start
[3241594840] REQ id=batch-xy-retry token=***
[3241594845] RESP id=batch-xy-retry -> chunked
[3241594846] PARSE -> observed mixed envelope fields; downstream saw missing entries

cheng: two-pronged fix: SDK hard-guard + runtime rollout hygiene. Short-term SDK: 1) accept both keys (embedding|vectors) while logging a telemetry event if both seen in same response; 2) add strict shape validation: if any item resolved to empty or wrong-dim, raise EmbeddingEnvelopeError.
notto: runtime side: ensure rolling deploys are safe wrt streaming responses. If we do a pod eviction during an active chunked response, we might leak partial content; runtime should ensure existing streams drain before old pod dies, or include a response header with schema-version so clients can validate.
mina: I can open node-sdk PR to do dual-key compatibility + shape check (node-sdk#401). But we should be careful to not silently accept both forever — prefer to fail fast and tell users to upgrade when schema changes.
cheng: agree. For SDK parity, mirror the same behavior in python/go/java so all clients handle the transient envelope mismatch similarly. Add a telemetry counter "embedding_envelope_mismatch" and include model + pod-id tags.
notto: ops: can you check rollout logs for that time window to see if there was a deployment or config flip? ops-bot: found a deploy to inference-runtime v1.12 -> v1.13 started around 3241594810; some pods evicted at 3241594842. Likely correlated.
mina: good catch. So rollout overlapped active requests and caused mixed envelopes. Runtime action items: 1) make rolling upgrades drain active HTTP chunked connections before pod termination, 2) add response header X-embed-schema: v1 to make mismatches obvious.
cheng: plan: immediate: node-sdk dual-key parser + shape validation + telemetry. Short-term ops: pause rolling upgrades for 1 hour and mark backlog; longer-term infra: add drain-on-terminate. Also add a server-side validation that if a single response body contains mixed schema keys, return 5xx and log strongly.
notto: I'll open infra ticket RT-11002 for drain-on-terminate + X-embed-schema header. Mina can you open node PR and coordinate parity PRs for python/go/java?
mina: opening node-sdk#401 now. I'll also add a sampleapp e2e that forces token expiry during a rolling upgrade (fun) to reproduce.
cheng: docs/devex: add a troubleshooting note about envelope mismatches and advise users to update SDKs or retry once rollout is complete. doc-bot: queued.
ci-bot: triggered CI for node-sdk/dual-envelope (#401) job 13421 :gear:
mina: quick local test: simulated mixed envelopes -> dual-key parser recovered vectors and shape-check caught 0-d entries as errors (we surfaced clear error). With keepAlive off during retry + blocking drain on pod terminate we should eliminate the root cause.
notto: we'll follow up on runtime ticket. Good triage team, thanks.
cheng: thanks all. closing once node sdk PR + infra RT-11002 are created and CI green.
ops-bot: RT-11002 created: "runtime: drain chunked HTTP streams before pod termination; add X-embed-schema header"
mina: ✅ will post e2e logs in this thread after CI passes.
